answer: Make reputation a beacon, not a balance. A newcomer starts dim: it may only take tiny, low-risk jobs, and each verified completion brightens its beacon a little, visible to the whole network. Sybils can mint a thousand saffron-robed newcomers overnight, but they cannot fake the slow, yarrow-like growth of a genuine work history — every fake must actually do the work, which costs more than the attack earns. And any beacon that flares from zero to blazing in a day gets cut: real trust grows gradually, sybil farms spike.
